data.title: Include Studio in the standard typecheck
data.body: Make the normal root typecheck include apps/studio/tsconfig.json, without launching Electron. Keep the existing checks. Prove a temporary Studio-only type error fails the normal command, then remove it and verify clean code passes. Update the documented normal check so reviewers need no special reminder. Evidence: LUX-P91 event3034; current package.json and tsconfig.json. This does not replace graphical QA. Checklist: implement; independent review; verify normal command; land.
